environment: Local PostgreSQL; test Auth/Storage scaffolding only, no real Supabase Auth/REST/JWT

results.test: Replay migrations; search_public_events is SECURITY INVOKER with empty search_path
CA R4-01.01/02: title and description match, case-insensitive, repeated with different text
CA R4-01.03/04: non-matching events are not returned; no-match query is an empty list, not an error
Wildcards %, _ and \ are literal; injection text is inert
Blank/null query is neutral, trimmed, and length is bounded in SQL
Universe: public, not cancelled/archived/finished; unlisted never returned; in-progress included
CA R4-02.01: one or several categories (OR)
Inactive categories are ignored; [] and null are neutral (CA R4-02.03: removing a selection restores results)
CA R4-02.02/04: text AND categories AND bounds; empty intersection is an empty list
A/B authenticated users see the same public result; anonymous is denied
Keyset cursor is stable with no duplicates; invalid cursor/bounds are rejected
CA R4-03.01: a single day is complete [00:00, next 00:00) in Argentina; a midnight-crossing event counts on its start day
CA R4-03.01/02: inclusive range by starts_at only; an event that started before the range is excluded even if it ends inside
CA R4-03.02: events outside the period are not returned (empty list, not an error)
CA R4-03.03: inverted range, "to" without "from" and absurd years are rejected in SQL
CA R4-03.04: clearing the dates restores other days and keeps the remaining criteria (text)
Day boundaries do not depend on the session/browser time zone (Tokyo session returns the same Argentina day)
CA R4-04.01/02: 5 vs 25 vs 100 km return progressively larger sets; points just inside/outside 25 km are classified correctly
CA R4-04.03 / R4-02.02: radius AND category AND dates AND bounds AND text; empty intersection is an empty list
CA R4-04.04: zero, negative, NaN, huge, partial and out-of-range origin/radius are rejected in SQL (never silently ignored)
Radius crosses the antimeridian in both directions
Radius near the pole falls back to latitude + Haversine (no division by zero)
Hidden/cancelled/archived/finished events never appear with date and radius filters
